text:
morgan: Quick sync : cross-service cutover in 20m. Targets: API=v2.5.0, runtime=kernel-qt1.6, console=6.0.0, router=header-split-v4. Plan: staged rollout 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with a manual hold at 20% for KV/eviction check. Any blockers?

alex: +1. suggest extra 3m pause after 60% to watch p99 tail. Last time kernel bump caused tokenization latency for long sequences.

emily: console will enable asset-flag at +8m and set CDN TTL=45s for 15m. Release notes updated (assets + CSP header change).

jay: Observability has canaries: /health, /v1/chat/ping, /v1/embeddings/ping. Alert rule: error_rate >0.7% sustained 90s OR p95 >180ms -> initiate rollback. I'll post canary summaries after each stage.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by morgan: "crosscut-8002003001". Scheduled start in 20m. Pins: API=2.5.0, runtime=kernel-qt1.6. Rollback window: 45m after completion. To cancel: `/deploy cancel crosscut-8002003001`. Manual resume at holds: `/deploy resume crosscut-8002003001`.

morgan: Confirm rollback ordering: runtime -> api -> router -> console? Runtime first reduces kernel path risk.

alex: Agree. Runtime rollback target: kernel-qt1.5. API rollback target v2.4.9. Router revert header-split if headers break. Console last. Exception: if CSP breaks frontends, router revert first.

emily: I'll stand by for console edge invalidation. console rollback requires CDN purge which may add ~3-6m. Keep that in mind.

jay: I'll run final smoke at T-5: `curl -sS -I https://api.redwood.test/health | grep X-Runtime-Kernel` and `curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq -r '.status'`. Posting results here.

morgan: Add gating: require alex or jay approval to resume at 20% and 60%.

aldeploy: (typo) alex: ack will approve if p95 < 130ms and no errors.

deploy-bot: Note: PAUSE_AT_20 set with 10m manual gate. Auto-abort conditions attached. Streaming status to thread.

jay: Preflight commands at T-7: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq .` and `hey -z 10s -q 40 -c 8 https://api.redwood.test/chat` to check tail.

morgan: thanks team. I'll initiate at scheduled time and post each stage here. Ping this thread for any immediate rollbacks. :rocket:
